sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Clontarf" (cons 47). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number One, the area named for Clontarf, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
